title: Chipmunk Beach Chop
description: A pitched-up sawtooth vocal-chop hook that stutters and bounces in the high register. Vowel formants cycle through bright i-e-a colors while ply stutter, speed jumps, and pan throws make it feel like a chipmunk ad-lib surfing overhead. Over 16 cycles the bpf opens and the stutter density escalates before resetting.
code:
setcpm(98/4)
stack(
  note("<a4 e5 [a4 c5] [e5 g5]>/2").s("sawtooth")
    .vowel("<i e a>/2")
    .speed("<2 2 [2 4] 2>/4")
    .ply("<1 2 [2 4] 1>/4")
    .bpf(sine.slow(13).range(1800, 5200)).resonance(10)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.05, 0.95))
    .sometimesBy(0.2, x => x.speed(4))
    .vib("<6 8 12>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(16).range(0.1, 0.8))
    .crush("<12 8 6 12>/16")
    .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.28).pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.8, 0.2)))
    .delay("0.35:0.25:0.5").room(0.3)
    .attack(0.001).decay(0.08).sustain(0.4).release(0.05)
    .gain(0.82)
)
